projects.title: Synapse
projects.description: Synapse is an experimental multimodal AI pipeline focused on image and video generation, inference orchestration, and model interoperability. The project explores how modern diffusion models, LoRA fine-tuning, and video pipelines can be composed into scalable, reproducible workflows.The system supports modular model loading, prompt conditioning, and media-level transformations, with an emphasis on performance, controllability, and rapid experimentation. Synapse was built to better understand the practical constraints of deploying image and video generation systems, including memory management, model compatibility, and inference latency.The project serves as both a research sandbox and a production-oriented foundation for generative media applications.1st @ Hack RU - Educationdevpost submission - https://lnkd.in/e2bTSUY6youtube demo - https://lnkd.in/e54FzYr7

projects.title: Algora
projects.description: Algora is a fully personalized job application automation platform designed to help early-career engineers apply at scale without sacrificing quality. The system synthesizes a deep understanding of a candidate’s technical background by ingesting public portfolio data (GitHub repositories, Devpost projects, resumes, and file directories) with user consent.Algora aggregates and ranks public job listings based on technical fit, then generates role-specific applications and cover letters tailored to each posting. The platform emphasizes alignment between a candidate’s real experience and the requirements of each role, reducing generic applications while significantly improving application throughput.Built to validate whether automation can meaningfully improve hiring outcomes for technically strong but resource-constrained candidates.1st @ Hack NYUDevpost - https://lnkd.in/eGE7mGCE

projects.title: InstructifAI
projects.description: InstructifAI is an AI-powered presentation analysis platform designed to help speakers refine their delivery by providing real-time insights into audience engagement. Using advanced AI models, InstructifAI detects facial expressions, head nods, and attention levels to gauge interest. It also transcribes and analyzes speech to identify key moments where engagement fluctuates.Key Features:📊 Audience Interest Detection (AID) – Tracks facial expressions (FER) and head movement (NoddingPigeon) to assess audience engagement.🔊 Presentation Audio Transcription (PAT) – Uses WhisperAI and Deepgram for speech-to-text conversion and content analysis.🧠 AI Judge – Powered by Llama/Deepseek, delivering timestamped feedback and recommendations for improving presentation effectiveness.🎤 Ollama AI Agent/Coach – Personalized coaching and insights to elevate your speaking skills.With InstructifAI, presenters can gain data-driven insights to sharpen their communication skills, ensuring their message resonates with their audience.

projects.title: Medify
projects.description: Medify is an AI-powered healthcare tool designed to assist soldiers and field medics in high-pressure environments. It leverages advanced machine learning to provide rapid injury assessment and tailored treatment guidance. The solution incorporates two key AI models:Wound Identification Model: Built using Python, PyTorch, and TensorFlow, this model analyzes images of injuries to classify wound types and assess severity. It ensures precise, real-time identification to guide immediate care decisions.Privacy Censorship Model: Designed for secure environments, this AI model automatically censors sensitive wound images, maintaining privacy during assessments and data sharing.Technical Details:Backend: Developed with Flask and FastAPI for seamless communication and data processing.User Interface: Built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS, offering a clean and intuitive design.Data Security: Utilizes blockchain technology (Midnight protocol) to encrypt and securely store data, including soldier IDs, medkit inventories, and injury details.Key Features:Efficiency: Provides rapid, AI-driven injury analysis to save critical time in emergencies.Accuracy: Tailored recommendations for treatment based on available medkit supplies.Accessibility: Text-to-speech functionality offers hands-free treatment guidance.Emergency Alerts: High-confidence injuries trigger prompts to contact emergency services.Achievements:Medify was developed to address gaps in battlefield care and empower soldiers to respond effectively in the absence of medics. It combines cutting-edge AI with a user-friendly interface, bridging the gap between field conditions and professional medical care.Impact:Medify enhances emergency response efficiency, reduces mortality rates, and ensures secure handling of sensitive data, making it an indispensable tool for military and emergency medical applications.

projects.title: FraxAI
projects.description: Fraxai is an AI-powered healthcare tool designed to assist radiologists and nurses in the emergency room. It uses advanced machine learning to streamline fracture diagnosis and treatment. The solution incorporates two key AI models:Fracture Detection Model: Built with Python, PyTorch, and Detectron2, this model analyzes X-ray images to identify fracture types and their precise locations. It highlights the fracture areas directly on the X-ray image, providing a clear visual reference.Treatment Guidance Model: Using MLflow, this model processes the detection data to generate tailored treatment instructions for nurses. It ensures that even nurses with limited training can administer accurate and effective care.Technical Details:The backend leverages a Flask REST API for communication.The user interface is built with modern web technologies, including Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS, offering an intuitive and responsive design.Key Features:Efficiency: Fraxai minimizes the time required for fracture diagnosis and treatment planning.Accuracy: Provides reliable fracture identification and treatment guidance, improving outcomes.Accessibility: Bridges the skill gap for nurses, enabling better care delivery in high-pressure environments.Achievements: Fraxai was developed during a hackathon and won "Best Freshman Hack" out of 120 participating teams, including upperclassmen. It stands out for its innovative combination of AI, practical medical applications, and a seamless user experience.Impact: By saving radiologists' time and empowering nurses, Fraxai enhances the efficiency and quality of emergency medical care.
